# Zendesk

This app connects each caller's own Zendesk OAuth account. Its default export is
`defineApp(requirements, definition)`. The catalog builder sets the trusted tenant
constant in `configuration.ts` before serving the source. Tool input cannot select
an API host. The provider restricts credential requests to that tenant's hostname.

`currentUser`, `listTickets`, and `getTicket` explicitly run without approval.
`createTicket` always requires approval. Account health reads `/api/v2/users/me.json`
and identifies the connected user by ID and name.

## OAuth setup

Create a confidential local OAuth client in the same Zendesk tenant under Admin
Center > Apps and integrations > APIs > OAuth clients. Register the exact redirect
URI shown by the host's connection flow. Use these allowed scopes:

```text
tickets:read tickets:write users:read
```

The app requests those scopes and uses PKCE S256, JSON token requests, and
`client_secret_post`. The host supplies the OAuth client ID and secret through its
secure configuration. No credentials belong in source. Each caller links their
own account.

Authorization uses `https://<subdomain>.zendesk.com/oauth/authorizations/new`;
tokens use `https://<subdomain>.zendesk.com/oauth/tokens`. Refresh requests carry
`grant_type`, `refresh_token`, `client_id`, and `client_secret`. The host must
persist the new access and refresh tokens returned by Zendesk.

## Framework

`package.json` pins the prepared Basalt host framework,
`apps@0.0.1-beta.104-basalt.1`. Community publication uses a separate public
framework release from the chosen host and an approved publisher namespace. The source uses plain async TypeScript, `ctx.fetch`, and `decodeJson`.

## References

- [Author an app](https://executor.sh/docs/author-an-app)
- [Zendesk OAuth setup](https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408845965210-Using-OAuth-authentication-with-your-application)
- [Token API](https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/ticketing/oauth/grant_type_tokens/)
- [Refresh tokens](https://developer.zendesk.com/documentation/authentication/refresh-token/)
